Briefing: slow response while asking again (state 2 of 5: loading)

text.tspan: Loading during a slow response. Mock AI service in mode slow (12
s, just above the slowest strategy measured in the Phase 2 spike,
Elapsed seconds instead of a fake percentage: the model's
time varies, so the bar only shows activity.
Cyan scanning bar: cyan is used only for AI activity.

away (undo), so a slow model never blocks play.

answering, so the model is named "mock-ai (test mode)".
